## Publication and recovery provenance

All release artifacts retain the original [v2.0.2 source commit](https://github.com/ds1sqe/type-bridge/commit/f94703f4c9b44a965a089f85b47c17933f4d9be6)
and annotated tag object `e8f7a9c5c26dc1e415ae5707c337e79dddcafde6`. No artifact was rebuilt or
repacked, and no tag was moved.

The [original stable run](https://github.com/ds1sqe/type-bridge/actions/runs/34077021385)
passed every acceptance gate and published Cargo, npm, native-core PyPI and
GHCR. Its older PyPI uploader rejected metadata version 2.5 in the facade
before upload, so that run remains recorded as failed.

The unchanged facade wheel and source distribution were then published by a
[publisher-only recovery](https://github.com/ds1sqe/type-bridge/actions/runs/34086312651) after
a [nonpublishing rehearsal](https://github.com/ds1sqe/type-bridge/actions/runs/34086050458).
The [recovery control commit](https://github.com/ds1sqe/type-bridge/commit/d578cdf93bf5d2efc8d55c9b010f507975e7d149) is
distinct from the original artifact source. It uses the metadata-compatible
PyPA publisher v1.14.2 with normal Trusted Publishing and PyPI attestations.
No previously successful registry lane was republished.

The attached `v2.0.2-recovery-manifest.json` records original run/job/step,
archive and payload identities (canonical SHA-256 `9ed0cffae15440f5b47b7eb9f140d5c1c80f11629e118e10d2256bf15900cad4`).
The attached `recovery-promotion.json` is the signed promotion predicate binding
the original source and bytes to those recovery controls. OCI digests and
attestation links are in the unchanged `server-oci-release.json` asset.

Public package bytes and signatures were independently verified. Isolated
Python 3.12–3.14, Node and Rust consumers passed. This maintenance release does
not publish 2.1 or C support.
